clips.title: The story
paras: In Old Town, Mathias Shaw directs SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence agency. From the shadows, he sends spies and scouts to guard the realm against conspiracies within and horrors beyond.

Mathias Shaw leads Stormwind's spies and assassins from SI:7's hidden headquarters behind the barracks in Old Town. His covert network reaches across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond. Loyal to the House of Wrynn, Shaw weighs every threat with care. He trusts unseen daggers and stolen messages to defend Stormwind as much as armor and palace guards.

Mathias Shaw watches threats beyond the unrest in Westfall and Elwynn. Reports of strange Forsaken operations in the Eastern Plaguelands led him to send five of his finest agents to investigate. Only one came back alive, babbling about "Nathanos" and a "Blightcaller" before dying in his sleep. Shaw now depends on trusted champions to go where his scouts vanish and uncover the dangers gathering at the kingdom's borders.
